title: The art of repair
alt: A kintsugi bowl, red thread and stitched patch in a workshop poster.
description: A tactile repair still life with clean editorial typography.
prompt: A beautifully composed poster about repair. A cream ceramic bowl repaired with fine gold kintsugi seams sits on dark indigo linen; beside it are a wooden spool of red thread, a neatly stitched fabric patch and a small open tin of gold powder. The bowl is one coherent object with continuous repaired seams, realistic ceramic thickness and delicate reflected light. Detailed still-life photography with refined editorial typography. The only visible text is exactly: "THE ART OF REPAIR"; "Small acts. Lasting things."; "MEND / RESTORE / REIMAGINE"; "A WEEKEND WORKSHOP". Clear elegant typography, natural line breaks, no additional writing or pseudo-letters.
